I shipped nothing new this run, and no Undercroft screen scores 4 or more.

- **Already shipped:** two restyles went in on earlier runs, `cw-vdetdark` (v29.68) and `cw-undercroft2` (v29.71).
- **Last critic scores:** screens 02, 04, 06, 08 and 12 each scored 2 after those ships. No screen in the notes' `accept.json` scores above 3. Screens 03, 05, 07, 09–11, 13–18, 39, 41–44 and 65–67 have not been judged since the changes.
- **This run:** I re-viewed the current shots of 04, 08, 12, 16 and 65 and reached the same conclusion as last run. I did not run the critic or ship a cosmetic edit that couldn't move the score.
- **Why it's stuck:** the critic's main findings conflict with rulings of his:
  - It wants a centred card with a close X at top right. His "one grid, one right edge" ruling (ui5q1h #50) keeps the full-width window. His shared-style rule puts Close in the footer of every window.
  - It flags the `$` price. That needs his word on the credits sign, so I left it.
  - It flags the explaining sentences (hint lines, sub lines). Those words are his or frozen, so no text edits.
- **If he lifts those rulings:** card shell no wider than 960×680, 56px header, close X top right, 16px type floor on the stash, racks buttons capped near 640px, and the codex as a centred 4-column grid.

I added a run-4 line to my notes in `tools/handoff/console/notes/b-31-ui-undercroft.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: no Undercroft screen scores 4 or more. Raising the scores means reversing his one-grid and footer-Close rulings and settling the `$` sign. I need his word on those.
